summaryStyles.simple: Claude Code（クロード・コード）とは、パソコンの黒い画面（ターミナル）で指示を出すと、AIが代わりにプログラムの作成やファイルの操作を行ってくれるエージェントツールです。対話するだけでなく実際に作業を行ってくれるため実用性が高い一方、大事なファイルを勝手に書き換えないための権限設定や安全面の工夫が議論されています。

others.excerpt: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. others.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
others.excerpt: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: wget https://datasette.io/content.db uvx --with datasette-agent datasette \ --root --secret 1 \ -s plugins.datasette-llm.default_model ' { "model": "lmstudio-qwen", "model_name": "qwen/qwen3.8-27b", "api_base": "http://localhost:1234/v1" } ' content.db And you'll get a local server running a Datasette Agent instance powered by your local model! Tags: uv , datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai
